# Accordion (`accordion`)

Collapsible sections, one or many open.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAccordion` (types in `dist/web/data-display/accordion.d.ts`): `.mh-accordion` (`--plain | --separated`): `.mh-accordion__item`s, each a heading holding a `button.mh-accordion__trigger` (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`; `__icon`, `__title`, `__subtitle`, `__meta`, `__chevron`) and a `.mh-accordion__panel` (`role="region"`, `hidden` when closed). Up and Down, Home and End move between headers; Enter and Space toggle.

```ts
export function createAccordion(options: AccordionOptions): AccordionHandle;

export interface AccordionOptions {
  sections: readonly AccordionSection[];
  /** Ids open at the start. In `single` mode only the first is used. */
  open?: readonly string[];
  /** `single`: opening one closes the others. Default `multiple`. */
  mode?: 'single' | 'multiple';
  /** In `single` mode, the open section can't be closed by pressing it again. */
  required?: boolean;
  /** `plain` (default): one panel with dividers. `separated`: each section is its own card. */
  variant?: AccordionVariant;
  /** Heading level of the section headers; default 3. */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  onChange?: (open: string[]) => void;
}

export interface AccordionHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  open(): string[];
  setOpen(ids: readonly string[]): void;
  toggle(id: string, open?: boolean): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAccordion, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('Open: lights', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const accordion = createAccordion({
  mode: 'single',
  open: ['lights'],
  sections: [
    {
      id: 'lights',
      title: 'Lights',
      subtitle: '3 of 7 on',
      icon: 'lightbulb',
      content: createText('Lights turn off when a room has been empty for 15 minutes.', { tone: 'muted' }),
    },
    {
      id: 'climate',
      title: 'Climate',
      subtitle: 'Heating to 21°',
      icon: 'thermometer',
      content: createText('The target drops by 2° overnight.', { tone: 'muted' }),
    },
  ],
  onChange: (open) => (status.textContent = open.length ? `Open: ${open.join(', ')}` : 'All closed'),
});

document.body.append(accordion.el, status);
```

## React API

`Accordion` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createAccordion`; controlled through `open` / `onChange`, or uncontrolled.

```ts
export function Accordion({ sections, open, defaultOpen, mode = 'multiple', required = false, variant, headingLevel = 3, onChange, className }: AccordionProps);

export interface AccordionProps {
  sections: readonly AccordionItem[];
  /** Controlled open ids. */
  open?: readonly string[];
  /** Uncontrolled: open at the start. */
  defaultOpen?: readonly string[];
  mode?: 'single' | 'multiple';
  required?: boolean;
  variant?: AccordionVariant;
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  onChange?: (open: string[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export interface AccordionItem extends Omit<AccordionSection, 'content'> {
  content?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Accordion, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function AccordionExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string[]>(['lights']);
  return (
    <Accordion
      mode="single"
      open={open}
      onChange={setOpen}
      sections={[
        {
          id: 'lights',
          title: 'Lights',
          subtitle: '3 of 7 on',
          icon: 'lightbulb',
          content: <Text tone="muted">Lights turn off when a room has been empty for 15 minutes.</Text>,
        },
        {
          id: 'climate',
          title: 'Climate',
          subtitle: 'Heating to 21°',
          icon: 'thermometer',
          content: <Text tone="muted">The target drops by 2° overnight.</Text>,
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```
